defects.description: The already-sent (SentAt != nil) check and the zero-quantity skip were removed from SendRestock, so every call now builds and sends a supplier email. Worker.Run in internal/restock/worker.go re-queues the job via retry whenever SendRestock returns an error (for example when MarkSent fails after mailer.Send succeeded), so the supplier receives the restock email again, including for zero-quantity orders.
